text:
arjun: FYI we're switching the slate-kernel bundle (slate-kernel:v7 + quant-2.3) into gradual rollout tonight 23:45-00:45 UTC. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holds on each step.
mai: I'll take ownership of the rollout ops. nate will monitor perf and alerts. zoe on rollback readiness.
nate: I'll add p95 decode, token error rate, and scheduler queue depth to the dashboard slices. also watch memory growth.
zoe: Let's set a conservative pin TTL: 3h on last-stable so we can flip quickly if needed. @deploybot can you default to pin TTL=3h for this run?
deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled deployment: slate-kernel:v7 quant=2.3 slices=[5%,25%,50%,100%] window=23:45-00:45 UTC. pin TTL=0 by default.
arjun: Set pin TTL=3h. Rollback criteria: token-error-rate delta > 2% absolute OR sustained p95 increase > 40ms across two consecutive slices. Manual rollback allowed on any crash loop.
mai: Agreed. I'll also run the preflight smoke matrix: short prompt perf, 2x long prompt stress, kv-cache checksum, and a model-agnostic rerank test.
nate: Preflight now. quick logs: no crashes, p95 +6ms, qps stable. kv-cache warmup 58% -> 70% over first 5 requests.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] preflight-job #889 passed: 6 checks OK.
mai: Good to go. starting 5% canary in 5m. I'll ping on slice transitions.
arjun: Add a short release-note bullet: "Slate-kernel:v7 adds scheduler preemption that targets batch balancing; quant-2.3 includes small bias fixes for int8." keep it minimal.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=5% started at 3456789400 by mai.
mai: 5% looks quiet. p95 +12ms, token-error +0.2%. holding 10m.
nate: Telemetry steady. no OOMs.
mai: Moving to 25%.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=25% started.
mai: 25% slice shows p95 +28ms, token-error +0.9%. still within thresholds. holding.
zoe: Prepare last-stable tag: slate-kernel:v6 -> last-stable, digest sha256:ef12be34. I'll pin the image once we widen to 50%.
arjun: Good. If 25% holds for the hold window, proceed to 50%.
mai: Widening to 50% now.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=50% started.
mai: First minutes ok, p95 creeping to +44ms but not sustained across the two-minute check. token-error 1.1%.
nate: I'm seeing occasional scheduler queue spikes on a small subset (~0.3% hosts). investigating connection between preemption and queue depth.
zoe: If those hosts keep flapping, we should isolate and route around. prepare rollback steps.
mai: Hold at 50% for full 10m while we triage spike.
arjun: If we don't resolve within the hold, we cancel and rollback to v6. keep communication tight.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] alert: scheduler-queue-spike on pool-eu-3 at 3456791205. severity=warning.
nate: Found culprit: older driver on a subset of nodes causing slower kernel launches. patch rolling to those nodes now.
mai: After patch, p95 back to +20ms and queue depth normalizing.
zoe: Since we mitigated, proceed to 100% but keep pin and monitor for 1h post-widen.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=100% started at 3456792000.
mai: 100% rollout done. post-deploy metrics: p95 +18ms, token-error +0.6%, no new critical alerts.
arjun: Excellent. Post-deploy actions: 1) create a short post-deploy note in release channel 2) keep the last-stable pin for 3h 3) ops to run a full regression suite in next 2h.
zoe: Tagging release notes now and noting the transient queue spike and driver patch as a follow-up.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] regression-run #901 queued.
mai: Closing rollout thread unless any of you want to keep it open. thanks everyone for fast triage.
arjun: Closing in 30m if no alerts. Great job!
